title: Jagged Flaky Egyptian Phyllo Dough Pastry
description: A romantic Egyptian dish featuring vanilla bean paste, with a bitter and flaky texture, served on a talavera plate. This ovo-vegetarian friendly pastry is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter, vanilla bean paste, and deglaze fond to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the phyllo dough and cut it into small squares.
Place a small spoonful of the dough mixture onto the center of each phyllo square.
Fold the phyllo into triangles and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastries with the beaten eggs.
Place the pastries on a talavera plate and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pastries from the oven and let them cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the pastries warm and enjoy.
